lines.text: The LORD tells the Jews in Egypt that Jerusalem and Judah's cities lie in ruins because of their evil.
The LORD sent His servants the prophets again and again, but the people kept burning incense to other gods.
The LORD says the remnant in Egypt will die by sword or flood, and only a few fugitives will return.
The great assembly tells Jeremiah they will not listen and will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven.
The LORD says He will deliver Pharaoh Hophra to his enemies, just as He delivered Zedekiah to Sennacherib.
